fact: The pan is dishwasher safe; for the longest life, let it cool, wash with warm water and mild soap, and never rinse a hot pan with cold water.
source: Gorgias guidance 5326403 (product details, updated 4 Oct 2026); macro 247074

fact: Discolouration or dark buildup is carbonized oil from overheating, not a defect: a paste of baking soda and water scrubbed gently with a soft sponge removes it.

fact: Metal utensils are safe on the pan because there is no coating to damage; any marks are cosmetic.

fact: No seasoning is needed, but preheating is: heat the pan on medium for 2 to 3 minutes, never on high, because high heat is the number one cause of sticking.
source: Gorgias guidance 5326403 (product details, updated 4 Oct 2026); macro 247048

fact: Water drop test: a drop of water should form a ball that glides across the pan; if it evaporates instantly the pan is too hot, if it sits still it needs more time.
source: Gorgias guidance 5326403 (product details, updated 4 Oct 2026); macro 247048

fact: After the water test add about a teaspoon of oil, wait 10 to 15 seconds until it shines, then add dry food and let proteins release naturally before flipping.
source: Gorgias guidance 5326403 (product details, updated 4 Oct 2026)

fact: Care and use video: https://siraatskitchen.com/pages/care-use (and https://siraatskitchen.com/pages/non-stick-test).
